messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Bennett <julie.bennett@caresynchealth.com>, CareSync Security <security@caresynchealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: Console telemetry cookie mapping + SOC 2 info — post-demo follow-up

Hi Julie / CareSync team,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Per our discussion, summarizing the immediate items and what I'll follow up with: 

- SOC 2 status: Redwood is currently in the final preparation stage for a SOC 2 Type II audit. We completed the control baseline and are scheduling the external audit for Q4 2028. I attached a short executive summary (redwood-soc2-exec-summary.pdf) that outlines scope, timelines, and the controls we have in place today.

- GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR requirements for data subject requests and has DPA templates. For HIPAA, we offer a Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) with a BAA; our hosted API is not used for PHI unless covered by a BAA with Private deployment. Happy to connect you to our privacy team for a BAA discussion if you need that route.

- Vendor security questionnaire: I can start the vendor SQ intake. If you can share the questionnaire PDF, I will triage and assign pieces internally — Rafael (cc'd) will handle evidence and security controls.

- Console telemetry & cookie mapping: At a high level, the Redwood Console uses a combination of first-party session cookies (auth/session), first-party analytics cookies for usage telemetry (anonymized), and optional third-party CDN cookies for static assets. I attached a CSV export with the preliminary mapping (console-telemetry-mapping.csv). The mapping highlights where we collect telemetry (console, docs.redwood.ai, API request traces) and retention windows.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Julie — please drop the vendor questionnaire into reply (or attach to this thread).
2) I will confirm SOC 2 artifact availability and provide any interim evidence we can share pre-audit.
3) Rafael / Neha — will start filling the SQ and flag any items needing exec sign-off.

If there are any specific cookie names, consent model requirements, or data export obligations you need us to address up front, please call them out in your reply and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-exec-summary.pdf (2 pages), console-telemetry-mapping.csv (1 file)

Subject: Re: Console telemetry cookie mapping + SOC 2 info — post-demo follow-up

Julie / CareSync team — thanks for the questionnaire. I'm Rafael (Head of Security Ops) — I'll take point on the vendor SQ. Initial answers to your questions below, we can follow up with evidence links once I collect artifacts: 

- Telemetry PII: Console telemetry is designed to separate auth identity from usage telemetry. Session cookies contain a session identifier tied to an internal user record; however, the analytics telemetry we store for product usage is captured as pseudonymized identifiers and aggregated events. We do not persist raw user passwords or full OAuth tokens in telemetry storage.

- GDPR DSAR SLA: Redwood's default DSRS SLA is 30 days; we can discuss stricter SLAs contractually. Contact for DSARs: privacy@redwood.ai (Privacy Ops).

- SOC 2 artifacts: We can provide the control narrative, system architecture diagrams, and our evidence matrix now. The Type II auditor report will be available after the external audit completes (target Q4 2028).

- HIPAA / BAA: For customers requiring HIPAA, we recommend Private deployment with a signed BAA. We have a standard BAA template and a compliance checklist I can share.

I'll begin filling the questionnaire and will flag any items needing either legal or product input. If you can highlight priority sections (e.g., encryption, data retention, incident response), I'll prioritize those.

Link to interim artifacts (read-only): https://drive.redwood.ai/share/CSH-onboarding-soc2 (I'll add access for Julie/security).

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Security Ops, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
